description: This file contains utility functions for file management, including reading, writing, copying files, directory scanning, and version-controlled file handling, specific to a project involving HTML, CSS, JS, and JSON files.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory, not compatible with Windows.

methods.name: scandir
methods.description: Lists files in a directory with specified type.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Referenced but not defined in the provided code.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Referenced but not defined in the provided code.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Writes content to a file and updates counters.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads entire content of a file.

methods.name: find_files_in_dir
methods.description: Finds files in a directory, optionally filtered.

methods.name: get_counters
methods.description: Returns the count of specific file types.

methods.name: write_vc_file
methods.description: Writes version-controlled files, managing latest and specific versions.

methods.name: copy_dir
methods.description: Copies all assets from source to destination directory.

methods.name: process_files
methods.description: Processes and copies multiple files with optional processing function.
